away.summary: The Blue Jackets (9-12-0) are projected to start Cam Talbot in net. The team did not hold a morning skate, and Mikael Pyyhtia was recalled from Cleveland to make his season debut, replacing scratched forward Dmitri Voronkov. Steven Lorentz was reassigned to Cleveland, while Conor Garland and Sean Monahan remain out with upper-body injuries.

home.summary: The Devils (15-8-0) are projected to start Connor Hellebuyck in net. The team debuted four new forward line combinations following a 9-6 loss to St. Louis, with Stefan Noesen returning to replace scratched Lenni Hameenaho. Amadeus Lombardi will play his second straight game at center after being a healthy scratch the previous three games, while Seamus Casey joined the team for the skate for the first time since his September injury.
